title: 💰 Multiple Accounting & Finance Openings in Charleston, SC - NewsBreak
text:
7 hours ago Charleston’s finance scene is buzzing right now, especially around real estate and hospitality. Here are a few solid roles if you like numbers and want to grow your career here.
Analyst, Investment & Development Program Employer: Greystar Location: Charleston, SC Type: Full-time, 2-year rotational program Salary: Not listed; eligible for bonus program Early-career role for students earning a Bachelor’s in Real Estate, Finance, Economics, Business, Urban Planning, or related and graduating Dec 2026 or Spring 2027 . You’ll rotate across areas like acquisitions, development, portfolio management, and finance, build your modeling skills in Excel, and move into a permanent role after the program, with strong benefits, 401(k) match, PTO, and parental leave .
Corporate FP&A Analyst Employer: Greystar Location: Charleston, SC (on-site or willing to relocate) Type: Full-time Salary: Not listed; eligible for bonus program Great fit if you have 1–2 years in finance or accounting and want to support company-wide planning, forecasting, and KPI reporting . You’ll prepare management reports for the executive team, dig into budget vs. actuals, and build/maintain financial models, with access to comprehensive benefits, PTO, 401(k) with match, and sabbatical after 10 years .
